question_record.context: A security incident involved suspicious Azure Resource Management (ARM) activities by a user `Hailey Johnson`, who signed in to a risky session. This activity was flagged by Microsoft Defender for Cloud. One part of this incident indicates that the proxy IP address `???` was involved in the suspicious ARM operations. However, it is often seen in malicious activities when threat actors try to hide their source IP. Microsoft Defender for Resource Manager detected a resource management operation from an IP address that is associated with proxy services, such as TOR.
question_record.question: Can you identify the ResourceId related to the ARM operation from the suspicious proxy IP address?
solution: There were suspicious Azure Resource Management activities performed using IP address `253.1.244.215`.

A resource management operation from a suspicious proxy IP address associated with TOR was attempted on the Azure resource with ResourceId `/subscriptions/7e838342-601f-4552-9baf-0dfb300cf555/resourcegroups/ctfcat/providers/microsoft.devtestlab/schedules/shutdown-computevm-vnevado-dc`.

32.name: Suspicious Azure Resource Management activities by a risky user
32.description: Suspicious cloud Azure Resource Management (ARM) activities were performed by a user account that signed in to a risky session. This alert was triggered based on a Microsoft Defender for Cloud alert related to ARM and Microsoft Entra ID Protection risk scores.

25.name: Azure Resource Manager operation from suspicious proxy IP address
25.description: Microsoft Defender for Resource Manager detected a resource management operation from an IP address that is associated with proxy services, such as TOR. While this behavior can be legitimate, it's often seen in malicious activities, when threat actors try to hide their source IP.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'IP_Address'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
parameters: Suspicious Azure Resource Management activities by a risky user
